description_en: Queries a list of data sources
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-connections --project-id 76086 --name abc --connection-type rds --sub-type mysql --status ENABLED --env-type 1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConnections

parameters.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source belongs. You can call the [ListProjects](~~178393~~) operation to query the ID.
parameters.description_zh: 数据源所在的工作空间ID。您可以通过[ListProjects](~~178393~~)接口获取工作空间ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to query the ID

parameters.description_en: The name of the data source that you want to query.
parameters.help_en: The name of the data source that you want to query
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   odps
*   mysql
*   rds
*   oss
*   sqlserver
*   polardb
*   oracle
*   mongodb
*   emr
*   postgresql
*   analyticdb_for_mysql
*   hybriddb_for_postgresql
*   holo

parameters.description_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter is used in scenarios where a type includes subtypes. The following type and subtypes are supported:

*   Type: `rds`
*   Subtypes: `mysql`, `sqlserver`, and `postgresql`
parameters.description_zh:
连接串的子类型，针对某些父类型type中包含子类型的场景。目前有以下组合：
- 父类型：`rds`
- 子类型：`mysql`、 `sqlserver`或 `postgresql`。
